title: DigitFix
description: This mod adds translation from Roman numerals to understandable ones on enchantments.
body:
## **_DigitFix converts Roman numerals to Arabic numerals_**

# **Before**

![Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1ca6e72af812ebc316dd298ca00901998b1be3b.png)

![Helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ce87287a743097837115d183d1c24e3f5963068.png)

![Potion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b1ede1a7dcefd8626629fdbb575124b2ee8d511.png)

# **After**

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d44b82cc2f7bf98b3d410c7291bfe5b976408a6b.png)

![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2c062c325a5b5bd98a6188d85e3ecd6ffc4b85d.png)

![3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12fe0c4bb30428384806f9bb97bc82c2d9058bb9.png)



# **_The mod works in the following languages:_**

- af_za — Afrikaans — Afrikaans
- ar_sa — Arabic (Saudi Arabia) — العربية
- bg_bg — Bulgarian — Български
- ca_es — Catalan — Català
- cs_cz — Czech — Čeština
- da_dk — Danish — Dansk
- de_de — German — Deutsch
- el_gr — Greek — Ελληνικά
- en_gb — English (UK) — English (UK)
- en_us — English (US) — English (US)
- es_es — Spanish (Spain) — Español (España)
- es_mx — Spanish (Mexico) — Español (México)
- fi_fi — Finnish — Suomi
- fr_fr — French — Français
- hu_hu — Hungarian — Magyar

- zh_cn — Chinese (Simplified) — 简体中文
